name: tortoise-scroll
description: Local-first personal trading journal (TradeZella-style) with AI trading partner

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix server && npm ci --include=optional --prefix client && npm ci --prefix e2e
scripts.dev: node node_modules/concurrently/dist/bin/concurrently.js -k -n SERVER,CLIENT -c green,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix server && npm run lint --prefix client
scripts.format: npm run format --prefix server && npm run format --prefix client
scripts.e2e:install: npm ci --prefix e2e && npm run install-browsers --prefix e2e
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:client
scripts.ci:verify: npm run lint && npm run test:server && npm run test:client && npm run build:client
scripts.audit:deps: npm audit --workspaces=false && npm audit --prefix server && npm audit --prefix client && npm audit --prefix e2e
